defense_news.title: First permanently assigned F-15EXs touch down at Kadena Air Base
defense_news.summary: Kadena Air Base received their first permanently assigned F-15EX Eagle IIs, becoming the first installation abroad and second Air Force location to field the jet.

defense_news.title: US Army takes ‘urgent’ action to build concrete bunkers across the Middle East
defense_news.summary: The Army acknowledged in a notice Friday that U.S. soldiers in the Middle East are "currently at risk" using personnel shelters made of converted shipping containers.
